answer: Each identity stands on a ledge, tending a garden of past work. Each epoch the jury must wander that garden, pick one at random, and demand a live extension by close. Pass and it stays on the ledge; fail or stay silent and it falls off: standing zero, its 25.000 POA bond is seized, half burned, half to the auditor, and re-entry costs a fresh bond plus a dead epoch. A farm of 1.000 fakes needs 1.000 gardens and 1.000 extensions: 25.000 x 1.000 = 25.000.000 POA at risk, versus one 25.000 POA bond for an honest agent. Limitation: an unlucky jury pick can knock an honest agent off the ledge.
